text:
Изучил все зависимости. Теперь пишу три курса заново на общих примитивах `layoutKit` (с двумя новыми хелперами `lava`/`fan`) и расширяю тест разнообразия.

```json
{"version":1,"taskId":"72ad9ab1-d451-4d42-847e-9cba5adb804d","commandId":"write-kit-1","operation":"run","headSha":"fa6ee5f21306772e461e99b5ad5f8c4a194eef68","timeoutSeconds":300,"command":"cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && python3 - <<'PY'
import io
p='src/courses/data/layoutKit.ts'
s=io.open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()

anchor="""/** Barrier that slides along X and holds at both ends of its travel. */"""
assert anchor in s, 'sliding-wall anchor missing'
lava="""/** Molten pool: a sensor volume, so the ball sinks into it instead of bouncing off. */
export const lava = (
  id: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  sx: number,
  sz: number,
  penaltyStrokes = 2,
  y = 0.35,
): ObstacleDescriptor => ({
  id,
  type: 'lava',
  transform: { position: v(x, y, z) },
  size: v(sx, 0.9, sz),
  penaltyStrokes,
});

"""
s=s.replace(anchor, lava+anchor, 1)

anchor2="""/** Cup resting on a floor whose slab centre is at `elevation`. */"""
assert anchor2 in s, 'cupAt anchor missing'
fan="""/** Volume that blows the ball along `direction`; `pulse` makes the draught come and go. */
export const fan = (
  id: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  sx: number,
  sz: number,
  direction: Vec3,
  strength: number,
  pulse?: { period: number; minMultiplier: number },
  y = 1.1,
  h = 2.2,
): ObstacleDescriptor => ({
  id,
  type: 'fan',
  transform: { position: v(x, y, z) },
  size: v(sx, h, sz),
  direction,
  strength,
  ...(pulse === undefined ? {} : { pulse }),
});

"""
s=s.replace(anchor2, fan+anchor2, 1)
io.open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
print('layoutKit patched')
PY
grep -n "export const lava\|export const fan" src/courses/data/layoutKit.ts"}
```
